linhas.en:
Meltlilith's third SG.
It's not an SG that represents a secret in her heart,
but rather a genuine, hidden crime.

To make herself invincible, Meltlilith rewrote a basic rule
on the Far Side of the Moon: "Loss of sense of time"
to "Loss of hit detection on Meltlilith."

Meltlilith's victory wasn't guaranteed by this contrivance,
but this cheat was checked by her parent BB,
and she was thrust from her place as star of the stage.

             ◆

In classical ballet, a superior dancer makes themselves
feel weightless, allowing them to dance like a feather.
This may be why Meltlilith, who adores ballet,
would come to picture the form of invincibility as
"a solitary, untouchable prima donna".
